description: Use right before signing a transfer your agent built from an instruction like "send 5 USDC to X". Confirms the transaction moves exactly that token, amount and recipient and nothing else, catching hallucinated amounts, wrong decimals and injected instructions. Compares a transaction against the stated intent field by field (asset, amount in exact base units, recipient, sender), flags every instruction that is not part of the transfer, and checks the simulated balance changes so funds moved any other way are caught. Inputs: transaction: The unsigned (or signed) transaction, serialized and base64-encoded. Legacy and v0 transactions with lookup tables are supported. Signatures are not checked. intent.token: What should be sent. intent.amount: How much should be sent, in human units, e.g. "5" for 5 USDC. intent.recipient: The wallet that should receive it (the person, not their token account). intent.sender (optional): The wallet that should pay. Defaults to the transaction's fee payer. intent.action (optional): The kind of intent. Only transfers are supported today. network (optional): Solana cluster to read. Defaults to "mainnet-beta" (real funds). Cost: 25 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC per call (x402). Full field-by-field docs: GET /api/tools/check_transaction_intent.
name: check_transaction_intent
